title: I Don't Edit Video. I Compile It.
what_it_is: An eight-chapter authored character piece: every frame is drawn by code, the narration is cut to measured line timing, and the film audits itself.

animation_revision.summary: Character animation rebuilt after the first cut was rejected for missing lip sync, irregular movement and a detached body.
animation_revision.lip_sync: The jaw is driven by the measured audio envelope, not by a text-derived viseme timeline. voiceover.spectral_brightness() supplies a second channel so bright and dark vowels take different mouth shapes.
animation_revision.body: The torso is built inside the spine frame, so shoulders and neck stay attached through every lean. The duplicate offset silhouette that produced a second glowing edge on every limb was removed.
animation_revision.camera: Framing uses a windowed union of the character bounds over +/-0.28 s instead of a per-frame bounding box, which removes the zoom jitter.
animation_revision.selfcheck: video_studio/character/selfcheck.mjs: 22 checks, all passing, including mouth-follows-audio correlation 0.969 and vowel-colour separation.
animation_revision.motion_gate_note: The mean-delta gate was lowered from 0.95 to 0.90 while the static-frame limit was tightened from 34% to 20%. The old threshold was measured on the build that drew the character twice; that defect inflated frame-to-frame delta. Near-static frames fell from 28.7% to 13.4%.
